headline: Concord catch Charleston as Davis & Elkins drop points
dek: Concord's win over Salem took them to twenty-seven points, level with Charleston, while Davis & Elkins, held at home by West Liberty, sit a point behind. Each of the three has lost once in conference play, and Davis & Elkins have played a match more than either leader.
displaced_by: Concord beat Salem to draw level with Charleston on points, and Davis & Elkins drew; Charleston no longer lead by two and Concord no longer trail by three

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Charleston have scored more goals than West Liberty and Wheeling together, and fifteen different players have shared their forty-three; the scoring is spread, not carried.

wire.line: The leaders, level on points, have still to play each other, and that meeting is at Concord.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Concord have conceded seven goals in fourteen matches and won ten of them.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: West Virginia Wesleyan are without a win after thirteen matches, with three draws and ten defeats, and have conceded forty-three goals.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Frank Stare has seven goals and four assists for Frostburg State from thirty shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Hugo Fauli has seven assists and three goals for Davis & Elkins.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Shai'ya Fitzgerald has made fifty-nine saves for West Liberty and conceded thirteen goals.

last_match.line: Concord have now beaten Salem home and away without conceding to them in either meeting.

next_match.line: Charleston won the first meeting on Salem's ground; Salem have yet to take a point from either leader.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
